scenes.title: Crowd on the platform
scenes.credit: State Library of Queensland (Public Domain), via Wikimedia Commons
scenes.anomaly: Time traveler: young man with modern sneakers under his trousers
scenes.explanation: Modern sports shoes made of synthetic materials only appeared from the 1960s on, more than 20 years after this photo.
scenes.description: Crowd on the platform of South Brisbane Interstate Station, March 1940, farewell for soldiers (caption of the State Library of Queensland).
hints: He stands in the middle of the crowd, not at the edge.
The young man in suit and hat at the bottom right: modern sneakers flash out from under his trousers.

scenes.title: Fair in Oxford Street
scenes.anomaly: Time traveler: young woman with sunglasses in her hair and a daypack
scenes.explanation: Modern plastic sunglasses and nylon backpacks only appeared from the 1960s/1970s on, long after this photo.
scenes.description: A tightly packed crowd at the Oxford Street Fair, October 1912; in the foreground musicians with brass instruments and drums.
hints: The young woman at the bottom left in the crowd: she wears modern sunglasses pushed into her hair and a backpack.

scenes.title: Official ceremony at King George V Square
scenes.credit: State Library of Queensland (No restrictions), via Wikimedia Commons
scenes.explanation: Flying saucers are a 20th-century science-fiction motif and do not exist, so a UFO cannot appear in any photo.
scenes.description: Large crowd at King George V Square in front of Brisbane City Hall at an official ceremony; in the foreground the equestrian statue of George V.
hints: Top edge of the frame, center.
High up in the sky, small and distant: a flying saucer.

scenes.title: Abingdon Square
scenes.explanation: PET plastic bottles only appeared in the 1970s, almost 70 years after this photo.
scenes.description: Street scene at Abingdon Square in New York City, 1907, with horse-drawn wagons and passers-by; on the right the building with the “Abingdon” sign.
hints: It lies on the ground at the edge of the street.
At the bottom left on the curb, half in shadow: a plastic bottle.

scenes.title: Bazaar street in Asakusa, Tokyo
scenes.explanation: Disposable paper cups with lids only appeared in the early 20th century, decades after this photo.
scenes.description: Bazaar street in the Asakusa district, Tokyo. The two figures in white are policemen according to the caption; stalls with goods line both sides of the street.
hints: It stands on the ground, not on a table.
On the ground on the right next to the building: a paper coffee cup with lid.
